import type postgres from "postgres";
import { dbOf } from "./module-db.ts";
const sql = dbOf("publication");
type Part = postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>;
type Parts = Part[];
type MaybePart = Part | number;
type PromiseView = PromiseLike<postgres.Row[]>;
type BrandedPart = Part & { readonly marker?: "fragment" };

export function directAlias(value: Part) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function directUnion(value: MaybePart) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function directArray(value: Parts) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function directRecord(value: { part: Part }) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function recordMember(value: { part: Part }) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value.part}`;
}
export function directPromiseLike(value: PromiseView) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function genericPromiseLike<T extends PromiseView>(value: T) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function intersectionQuery(value: BrandedPart) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value}`;
}
export function stringAssertion(value: Part) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value as unknown as string}`;
}
export function anyAssertion(value: Part) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${value as any}`;
}
declare function erasedQuery(): PromiseView;
export function erasedQueryCall() {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${erasedQuery()}`;
}
function queryAsString(): string {
  return sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)` as unknown as string;
}
export function stringReturnCall() {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${queryAsString()}`;
}
export function mutableTableName() {
  let table = () => "publications";
  table = () => "receipts";
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM ${sql(table())}`;
}
export function mutableRawText() {
  let statement = () => "SELECT 1 FROM publications";
  statement = () => "DELETE FROM receipts";
  return sql.unsafe(statement());
}
function anyAsText(value: any): string {
  return value;
}
export function anyReturnProducer(value: any) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${anyAsText(value)}`;
}
const aliasedStringProducer = queryAsString;
export function aliasedErasedProducer() {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${aliasedStringProducer()}`;
}
const objectStringProducer = { value: queryAsString };
export function objectErasedProducer() {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${objectStringProducer.value()}`;
}
export function inlineErasedProducer(value: Part) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${(() => value as unknown as string)()}`;
}
export function destructuredErasure(value: { part: Part }) {
  const { part } = value as unknown as { part: string };
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${part}`;
}
export function reboundScalarParameter(value: Part) {
  let bound = "safe";
  bound = value as unknown as string;
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${bound}`;
}
export function reboundRecordParameter(value: Part) {
  const record = { part: "safe" };
  record.part = value as unknown as string;
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${record.part}`;
}
export async function awaitedRecordErasure(value: Part) {
  const record = Promise.resolve({ part: value }) as unknown as Promise<{ part: string }>;
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${(await record).part}`;
}
export function pushedErasedQuery(value: Part) {
  const values = ["safe"];
  values.push(value as unknown as string);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${values}`;
}
export function assignedErasedQuery(value: Part) {
  const record = { part: "safe" };
  Object.assign(record, { part: value as unknown as string });
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${record.part}`;
}

export function soundnessScalarControl(title: string, id: number, tags: string[]) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE title = ${title} AND id = ${id} AND tags && ${tags}::text[]`;
}
export function soundnessLiteralControl() {
  return sql`SELECT ${"DELETE FROM receipts"} FROM publications`;
}
declare function parseSchema<S>(schema: S, input: unknown): { [K in keyof S]: S[K] extends () => infer V ? V : never };
const dataSchema = { title: () => "", count: () => 1 };
export function soundnessMappedDtoControl(input: unknown) {
  const row = parseSchema(dataSchema, input);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE title = ${row.title} AND id = ${row.count}`;
}
declare function declaredMixedDto(input: unknown): { title: string; privateValue: unknown };
function localMixedDto(privateValue: unknown): { title: string; privateValue: unknown } {
  return { title: "known", privateValue };
}
function localErasedMixedDto(value: Part): { title: string; privateValue: unknown } {
  return { title: value as unknown as string, privateValue: null };
}
export function soundnessDeclaredDtoFieldControl(input: unknown) {
  const row = declaredMixedDto(input);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE title = ${row.title}`;
}
export function soundnessLocalDtoFieldControl(input: unknown) {
  const row = localMixedDto(input);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE title = ${row.title}`;
}
export function selectedUnknownDtoField(input: unknown) {
  const row = localMixedDto(input);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${row.privateValue}`;
}
export function selectedErasedDtoField(value: Part) {
  const row = localErasedMixedDto(value);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${row.title}`;
}
export function commaErasedParameter(value: Part) {
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${(0, value as unknown as string)}`;
}
export function spreadOverridesSelectedField(value: Part) {
  const record = { part: "safe", ...{ part: value as unknown as string } };
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${record.part}`;
}

type DataRow = { id: number; next: number; config_hash: string; rejected: number; privateValue: unknown };
async function typedRows() { return await sql<DataRow[]>`SELECT * FROM publications`; }
async function typedSavedRow() { const [row] = await typedRows(); return row!; }
export async function soundnessTypedReassignmentControl(flag: boolean) {
  let draft: DataRow | undefined;
  if (flag) [draft] = await typedRows();
  draft ??= await typedSavedRow();
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE id = ${draft!.id} AND hash = ${draft?.config_hash ?? null}`;
}
function firstTyped<T>(rows: readonly T[]): T {
  const row = rows[0];
  if (row === undefined) throw Error("missing");
  return row;
}
export async function soundnessGenericProjectionControl() {
  const { next } = firstTyped(await typedRows());
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE id = ${next}`;
}
function normalizedValue(input: string): string | null {
  let url: URL;
  try { url = new URL(input.trim()); } catch { return null; }
  url.hash = "";
  let value = url.toString();
  if (value.endsWith("/") && url.pathname !== "/") value = value.slice(0, -1);
  return value;
}
export function soundnessComputedStringControl(input: string) {
  const value = normalizedValue(input);
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE url = ${value}`;
}
export function soundnessDtoSelfSpreadControl(query: { source?: string; from?: Date; privateValue?: unknown }) {
  query = { ...query, from: new Date() };
  query = { ...query, source: query.source?.trim() };
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE source = ${query.source}`;
}
async function typedOutcome() {
  const [row] = await typedRows();
  return row ? { rejected: Number(row.rejected), privateValue: row.privateValue } : null;
}
export async function soundnessAwaitedDtoControl() {
  const result = await typedOutcome();
  return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE rejected = ${result?.rejected ?? 0}`;
}

export function computedFieldErased(q: Part) {
  const r = { ["v"]: q as unknown as string }; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r.v}`;
}
export function spreadFirstErased(q: Part) {
  const r = [...[q as unknown as string]]; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r[0]}`;
}
export function spreadShiftErased(q: Part) {
  const r = [...["safe",q as unknown as string],"safe"]; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r[1]}`;
}
export function constantKeyRebound(q: Part) {
  const r = {v:"safe"}; const k = "v"; r[k] = q as unknown as string; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r.v}`;
}
export function dynamicKeyRebound(q: Part, k: "v" | "other") {
  const r = {v:"safe",other:"safe"}; r[k] = q as unknown as string; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r.v}`;
}
export function computedDestructuringErased(q: Part) {
  const r={v:"safe"}; ({["v"]: r.v}={v:q as unknown as string}); return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE ${r.v}`;
}
export function soundnessComputedArrayControl() {
  const r = {["v"]:"safe"}; const a=[...[r.v],"safe"]; return sql`SELECT 1 FROM publications WHERE title=${a[1]}`;
}
